import settings


def test_wechat_work_config_exists():
    assert hasattr(settings, 'WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG'), '缺少企业微信机器人推送配置'
    config = settings.WECHAT_WORK_CONFIG
    assert isinstance(config, dict)
